title: Can a BVN Number Be Changed? What You Can Correct
excerpt: Your 11-digit BVN and the demographic details linked to it are different. Learn what can be corrected online, what cannot be replaced, and how to unblock your accounts.
keywords: can I change my BVN number
is it possible to change BVN

sections.content: You generally do not replace your 11-digit Bank Verification Number because a name, date of birth, or phone number is wrong. A BVN is a unique biometric identifier permanently linked to your facial profile and fingerprints across the entire Nigerian financial system. The lawful remedy is not to generate a new number, but to update the supported demographic details attached to your existing BVN through an approved banking process. To view the exact demographic details currently attached to your biometric profile, you can retrieve and print your verified BVN slip online.

sections.title: Need to Correct Your BVN Details Without Bank Queues?
sections.content: While the 11-digit number itself is permanent, misspelled names, wrong dates of birth, and unlinked phone numbers can be corrected online. Avoid stressful bank branch queues and court affidavit delays by submitting your lawful demographic update through the Ufriends IT BVN Modification Portal.

Attempting to enrol for a fresh BVN to bypass a mismatch, debt, account freeze, or compliance flag is illegal and triggers automated fraud watch-lists under Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and NIBSS guidelines. If someone promises to give you a \"new BVN\" to erase an error, decline immediately. The only legal, permanent solution is to correct your recorded demographic data so it aligns seamlessly with your National Identification Number (NIN) and legal identification documents.

sections.content: Which BVN Details Can Be Corrected?

Central Bank of Nigeria regulatory frameworks allow customers to rectify legitimate demographic errors provided they supply authentic supporting documentation. Here is a breakdown of what can be modified:

items: Minor Name Corrections: Typographical errors, spelling slips made during enrolment (e.g. \"Muhammed\" instead of \"Mohammed\"), and rearranged first/middle/last names.
Marriage Name Changes: Women updating their surname following marriage, supported by an official marriage certificate and newspaper publication.
Date of Birth Corrections: Adjusting inaccurate birth dates to align with your National Identification Number (NIN) and National Population Commission (NPC) records.
Phone Number Updates: Replacing a lost, damaged, or unlinked SIM line with your current active mobile phone number to restore OTP delivery.

sections.content: Why Duplicate BVN Enrolment Is Dangerous

Because the BVN architecture uses biometric algorithms (10-fingerprint scans and high-resolution facial recognition), any secondary enrolment attempt triggers a biometric collision in the central NIBSS database. When a duplicate enrolment is detected, the automated fraud system flags all linked bank accounts, placing them on \"Watch-List\" or Post-No-Debit (PND) status.

Crucial Compliance Warning: Never attempt a fresh BVN registration to fix an error or evade an account restriction. Resolving a duplicate BVN flag requires administrative clearance from multiple financial institutions and months of investigation. Always modify your existing record through the official Ufriends IT BVN portal.

items.q: Can someone have two BVNs in Nigeria?
items.a: No. The CBN and NIBSS enforce a strict one-person, one-BVN policy enforced by biometrics. Enrolling twice creates duplicate identity flags that restrict all your bank accounts.

items.q: How long does a BVN detail correction take to reflect?
items.a: While traditional bank branch visits can take 5 to 7 business days, submissions made through the Ufriends IT verified portal are processed rapidly, with automated status updates visible on your dashboard.

items.q: Can I correct my BVN name and date of birth at the same time?
items.a: Yes, provided you provide consistent legal documents (such as an aligned NIN slip and birth certificate) proving both details concurrently.

items.q: How do I confirm my BVN update was successful?
items.a: You can print a fresh official BVN slip with passport photograph directly from the Ufriends IT portal to verify that your corrected details now appear centrally.
